gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: Condensing
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 正在凝聚

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: Condenses one %2$s every %1$s s
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 每 %1$s 秒凝出一个%2$s

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: Disabled
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 已停用

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: Nobody placed this condenser by hand, so it won't work. Break it and place it again yourself
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 这台凝聚器不是玩家亲手放下的，不会工作；拆下来自己重新放一次

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: Pick a target
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 选一种目标

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: Click one of the mineral icons below to choose what to condense
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 点下面的矿物图标，选一种要凝聚的东西

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: Not accepted
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 不收这一种

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: This condenser does not make that one; pick another
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 凝聚器现在不凝这一种，换一种吧

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: No ley line here
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 这里没有地脉

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: This dimension has no ley line, so only the Nether Star can be condensed here
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 这个维度没有地脉，这里只能凝下界之星

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: You have one here
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 已有你的凝聚器

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: Your earlier condenser at (%s, %s, %s) already uses this chunk's ley line; this one waits
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 你在（%s, %s, %s）更早放下的凝聚器已经占用了这个区块的地脉，这台先等着

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: Break that one, or move this one to another chunk
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 拆掉那台，或者把这台搬到别的区块

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: Too many running
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 同时工作的太多

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: At most %s of your condensers work at the same time, and your earlier ones are already running
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 你同时最多有 %s 台凝聚器在工作，更早放下的几台已经占满了

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: Break one of them or clear its target; this one then starts within a few seconds
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 拆掉其中一台，或者取消它的目标，这台几秒内就会接上

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: Output full
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 输出格已满

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: Take items out of the output slots and it resumes by itself
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 取走输出格里的东西，它会自己接着凝

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: Too costly
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 容量不够

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: This target needs more MRU or ESPE per tick than the condenser can hold
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 这一种每刻要的 MRU 或 ESPE 比凝聚器能存的还多

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: Not enough ESPE
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: ESPE 不够

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.en: Place a ring of 8 crystal pillars one block away from the condenser at the same height; it draws ESPE from them
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.status.zh: 在凝聚器周围隔一格、同一高度摆一圈 8 根水晶柱，它从柱子里抽 ESPE

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.target.en: Draws about %s MRU per tick while condensing
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.target.zh: 凝的时候每刻约用 %s MRU

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.target.en: No ley line here: it can't be condensed in this dimension
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.target.zh: 这里没有地脉：这个维度凝不了它

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.target.en: Needs no ley line; ESPE comes from the 8 crystal pillars around
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.target.zh: 不需要地脉；ESPE 从周围 8 根水晶柱里抽

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.target.en: The condenser does not make this one
Condensing this. Click again to clear the target
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.target.zh: 正在凝它；再点一次取消目标

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.target.en: Switching clears the current progress; what was already used is not refunded
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.target.zh: 换目标会清空当前进度，已经用掉的不退

tooltip.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.en: Condenses the mineral you choose from the ley line, using MRU (and ESPE for Nether Stars). Never touches blocks in the world
tooltip.essentialcraft5.ley_condenser.zh: 用 MRU 从地脉里凝出你点名的矿物（下界之星另要 ESPE），世界里的方块一格不动
